name: Treasurer
description: A policy-gated Stripe Issuing test-mode spending demo with a persistent audit ledger.

DEMO_PASSWORD.description: Shared password for the demo dashboard.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret for this Heroku URL's Stripe test webhook; not the local CLI secret.

STRIPE_CARD_ID.description: Existing funded Stripe test Issuing card (ic_...).

STRIPE_ISSUING_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Only needed if the Issuing authorization endpoint has a separate signing secret.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Key for the configured purchase-email extraction model.

LLM_MODEL.description: Your working LiteLLM model ID; use the same model as the local demo.

COGNEE_SERVICE_URL.description: Your existing Cognee Cloud service URL.

COGNEE_API_KEY.description: Your existing Cognee Cloud API key.
